groups: being afraid of a threat: fear, dread, terror, panic, fright
renders being afraid of a threat
the fear that reveres: fear of the LORD, awe, reverence, what is awesome
fear in the body: trembling, quaking, shuddering, writhing
renders fear shown in the body
being appalled or horrified at what is seen
renderings with no sense of fear: desolation, waste, waves, an image, rage

H3374|fear: 'the fear of the LORD' (Isa 33:6, Prov 1:29); elsewhere a dread, settled per verse

anger at its height, often God's: wrath, fury
anger as a fire: kindled, burning, fierce, hot, smoking
anger roused by another: provoke, provocation, vexation, fretting
anger between people: quarrelling, strife, contention
renderings with no sense of anger: a lament, venom, a place's name, heat as temperature
